environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label set to 'restricted' profile at 'enforce' mode (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The cluster also has a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, not webhook) that evaluates spec.volumes and rejects any pod spec containing hostPath volume type or emptyDir with medium 'Memory' exceeding 64Mi. The container runs with securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drops ALL capabilities. An ephemeral volume (emptyDir) is mounted at /var/log/app for application logs. The HOST_AUDIT_PATH environment variable is unset. Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only kube-dns on port 53 and the application's own service mesh sidecar.
